description:
Stop a QA run you started. Applicants not yet accepted are turned down; accepted testers are told and may finish. Its schedule keeps going, and no tool stops a schedule.
Use for: ending one QA run early. Unused money returns immediately only without assigned work, completed work or paid results; otherwise it returns when the run closes. A stopped run cannot restart.
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: stop_qa_run({"runId":"qr_7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp"})
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: not_stoppable, run_busy; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: stop_qa_run

refundedSoFar.description: A running total of the run’s refunded funding that can grow while the run closes.

status.description: cancelled once the stop is done. reviewing while testers who hold work finish it. A run stopped earlier keeps moving after the stop, so a repeat can show closed.

completedAt.description: When the stop finished. Left out while draining.

requestedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

state.description: stopped: done. refundedSoFar is the run’s total refunded funding so far. draining: testers who hold work finish it and are paid; the rest comes back when the run closes, with no further call.

unsettledTesterCount.description: Testers on this run whose work, pay or refund is not settled yet.

title: Stop a QA run
